rules.statement: The interest of a mother in the acquired property of her husband is not defined with exactitude in Kandyan law; but it seems clear that it was regarded as nothing more than a usufruct.
rules.supporting_quote: "The interest of a mother in the acquired property of her husband is not denned with exactitude in Kandyan law ; but it seems clear from a number of incidental references that it was regarded as nothing more than a usufruct."
